_doc: Per-fighter framing for make-bust.mjs, measured on each generated master (fractions of its size): ex/ey = the eye line (eyes, visor slit or the glints in a hood), cy = the chin (or the bottom of the mask or helmet). The zoom brings eye-to-chin near 10.5% of the output (clamped to 0.92..1.1 so the painted body still fills the frame); s overrides it.
